items.title: Russell Brand prison message 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says
items.summary: Brand's wife read out comments from the comedian on their podcast in which the convicted rapist said he was "not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for".

items.title: Snow warning for large part of the UK
items.summary: A yellow warning for snow and travel disruption has been issued across a large part of the UK by the Met Office.

items.title: Barristers must stop using rape myths in trials, justice secretary says
items.summary: Russell Brand's barrister has been accused of peddling rape myths while defending the comedian.

items.title: Man in court after two killed in police chase collision
items.summary: A man charged with causing death by dangerous driving after two people were killed when a car being chased by police collided with their vehicle has appeared in court.

items.title: Create more jobs for under-25s by cutting National Insurance, key report urges
items.summary: Some parents are so desperate for their children to find a job that they've offered to pay their wages, one hairdresser has told the BBC.

items.title: Jensen Huang's possible return to Nvidia 'isn't a bad idea', says Donald Trump
items.summary: Donald Trump says the potential return of Jensen Huang as Nvidia boss "isn't a bad idea".
